name: Cargo, Please!
summary:
Cargo, Please! is a cozy, high-speed delivery game where you accept take-out deliveries, race across cities, and keep your cargo intact while the cops stay close behind. Drive fast, upgrade your truck, and find your rhythm on the road.

You play as a delivery truck driver taking on shipments across three cities. Each job starts the same way: accept a shipment, pick it up, and deliver it to the drop-off point. The twist is that not every delivery is safe, simple, or legal, and the police are always watching.

The game features replayable, fast-paced driving mixed with a cozy, lighthearted tone. Shipments are smartly auto-generated, so no two runs feel exactly the same. Some deliveries are quick and easy, others are long, timed, or more fragile. As you complete deliveries, you earn money and experience. Over time, you upgrade your truck to handle better shipments, unlock new trucks, access new cities, and expand your list of playable characters.

The world is open, with a full day and night cycle and dynamic weather. Between deliveries, you can switch things up in Taxi Driver Mode for a more relaxed experience.
